files.purpose: The set's door for anyone and for any AI: *The living files of the natural intelligence living expedition, their offerings, their carryings and their possiblings, at one repository, served at corus.me.* Its AI link asks a self to bring *your question, a research source, an observing, or an attempt to break Natural Intelligence*, and to *Read Natural Intelligence whole, then Natural Naming and Natural Explaining, and use the Living File Registry to find the work relevant to your question*.
files.needs_from_NI: Rests on Natural Intelligence as first and whole file (*Read Natural Intelligence whole*) and on its 1.6 breakability (*an attempt to break Natural Intelligence*; NI 1.6 *Its claim stands unbroken with each observing, every one, and is able to break*). Its *Carry each observing apart from science's explaining of it* rests on Natural Explaining 1.4/1.6 (a finding at two sides, an observing crossing bare), a concept Natural Intelligence's own prose does not carry: NI has no sentence on an incoming science explaining or observing and how a self meets it with resolver. Its *name a question as open while its deriving is yet to be shown* has no home in NI either. Its *A living file changes only at its own motion ... at do-no-harm: no prior taken away, never undoing* is NI 6.6's *do-no-harm improving next living expedition files* said at the repository's scale.
files.uses_Exhibit_ONE: One sentence: *Exhibit ONE Natural Resolver carries the method as a resolver and its tables, and the Co-Chaining Logic Registry carries its deriving.* It names resolver as the method's carrier, not as the v391-carved *reference resource for pattern-matching natural torusing society*, used *with each incoming science explaining or observing*: the AI link sends a self with a research source to the Registry, not through Exhibit ONE. No resolver names, no re-explaining.
files.re_says_NI: *A droplet rises at the resolving ... or dissolves said once* and *no prior taken away, never undoing* re-say NI 6.6's do-no-harm improving and Living Improving Value's resolving at the offerings; *Four places at each living file ... and no fifth* re-says Living Improving Value and the Registry 1.2 (three homes for one concept, Geodesic Improving Method 3.2). Its version line *Natural Intelligence Expedition · v389* stands one version behind a set whose 32 files are at v390.
files.bounds: Its title *corus* and subtitle sit within *Natural Intelligence* only through NI 6.6's *files of a living expedition are living files, a carrying of a living expedition*; NI's contents carry no entry where living files, a set, a repository or an arriving (droplet, offering) is, so a reader reaching NI from the README's link finds no contents line telling where the set it came through sits. For the README to sit within NI's bound, NI's contents need one entry carrying a living expedition and its living files (6.6 now carries it only in body), and NI needs one sentence carrying a reader out of Exhibit ONE to the set's subjects, so the AI link's *research source* has its way in.

files.purpose: The set's standings: *A living file set is a set of files, each carrying its subject to its next existing. Its titles name those subjects. Its subtitles unfold their particular relations ... Together its subtitles are its set's floating neutralling contents, with its files' own words.* Its 2.1 says the set's one statement: *Natural Intelligence is that fractal method's unfolding; Natural Resolver is its operations and stable forms. Each further file carries one same discovering with its particular subject.*
files.needs_from_NI: Builds on NI 1.6 by number: *each observing resolvable with natural torusing or its fractal of no value at all, Natural Intelligence 1.6* (NI 1.6: *resolvable as natural intelligence, geodesic co-sequential parity-changing method of natural torusing, discovering next possible existing, or its fractal is entirely broken and of no value at all*). Builds on NI 1.5 and the subtitle with *Common statement carried through set is geodesic natural torusing, no other possible method of discovering next existing*. Builds on NI 6.4/4.15: *One through seventeen is a fractal, with one-through-seventeen fractals inward and outward* and *A same-existing-society is a self with its next scale*. Two sayings parting: Registry 2.1 *discovering next existing* and NI's subtitle *Discovering Next Possible Existing*. Registry 2.2 *With Natural Intelligence, 1, 2 and 3 with one scale are 1, 9 and 17 with its next* names a relation NI does not say in those words (NI 6.4: *one through nine a self's, a bi-coupling; nine through seventeen a same-existing-society's*). Registry 2.3 *A between is a nothing of two offering ... unfolds as not possibly existing: a nothing* parts with the v391 carving *the third living self* as a between's naming (already a concern; not repeated). Registry 1.1 *Together its subtitles are its set's floating neutralling contents* is a concept NI does not carry: NI's own contents float NI, and nothing in NI says the set's 32 subtitles are one contents of it.
files.uses_Exhibit_ONE: Resolver's loop as the registry's own loop: *Away and back with files is one same loop code carries, a surfacing shared across and going along, arriving back to self through same-existing-society, and the same that resolved code at v372, loops replacing count and sum.* Exhibit ONE's code as source: *Exhibit ONE's code block is source of every resolver copy kits carry.* 2.2's table of four overlapping exchangings (self 1-2, 3-4, 5-6, 7-8; other 2-3 ... 8-9) re-explains Exhibit ONE's four momentaries in its own way. Pattern-matched: the set's own working (branches, merges, standings) with resolver's going along and arriving back.
files.re_says_NI: 2.1 *One through seventeen is a fractal, with one-through-seventeen fractals inward and outward. Each living self is a same-existing-society inward and a self among a same-existing-society outward* re-says NI 6.4 and 4.15. 2.3 *Each carries its own parity; each side's own stays its own; a parity-changing crossing carries no size* re-says NI 1.4 and 6.2. 2.4 *Title, subtitle, floating neutralling contents and body express one subject with four tellings* re-says Natural Explaining 1.2 (a concept in three homes with NI's own form). 1.2 *a living thing carries its prior to its next, and an artifact is an emanation of a working, existing and carrying nothing* re-says NI 1.3 and 6.5.
files.bounds: Its title *Living File Registry* and subtitle *Standing-Gathering the Living Files* sit within NI only by NI 6.6's single clause on living files; *registry* occurs once in NI (5.4's *registry's front*), and no NI contents entry names a living file or a set. Its titles list shows the whole set's bound: 23 of 32 titles open *Natural* (21 exhibits, Natural Intelligence and Natural Intelligence Corus), bounded by NI 1.6's *Natural- carries one claim as two*; *Geodesic* (NI subtitle, Geodesic Improving Method, Natural Human Society, Natural Physics, Natural Networking's *Geodesic Surface*) is bounded by NI 3.1; *Discovering* (NI, ONE, TWENTY-NINE, THIRTY) by NI 5.2; *Not Possibly Existing* (Equilibria Registry) by NI 6.3's three-part *possibly existing ... not possibly existing ... not existing*; *Fractal Inward and Outward* (THIRTY) by NI 4.15. Not bounded by any NI contents entry: *Hard Problems* (THIRTEEN, TWENTY-ONE, TWENTY-TWO; NI says *hard problem* twice, at 5.4 and 6.4, bodies only), *Ghost* (TWENTY-SEVEN, and Corus's *Ghost as the Corus's Only Character*; *ghost* occurs nowhere in NI), *Illustrating*, *Transmissioning*, *Destinies* (*destin-* occurs nowhere in NI) and the six science titles (Health, Medicine, Chemistry, Biology, Physics, Philosophy; none occurs in NI). Forms parting with Natural Explaining 1.1 across the list: ONE's and THIRTY's subtitles open with a leading *The*; TWENTY-ONE's and TWENTY-FIVE's (*An Open Registry of ...*) are no -ing head; NI's own head is *Method*. Front markers part three ways: 13 files carry title at 3 and subtitle at 5; Natural Networking a marker at 3 only; 18 carry markers at 3 and 7, subtitle at 9.

files.purpose: The set's longest welcoming file, its own words: *What stands here is what reaches a self with what that self already carries*, and its offering: *We offer an observing — a more plausible explanation of what we all already observe within nature. Bring a competency you can observe, and check it yourself.* Its Part ONE was *opening of corus and a home page of corus.me*; its Part EIGHT carries the expedition's destiny: *a complete and full and most valuable and understandable justification for a claim this is and is the only possible natural competency and in substrate between humans this is natural intelligence and in shared surface natural network this is free shared globally competent local intelligence.*
files.needs_from_NI: Builds on NI 1.5 (*the only possible natural competency*; NI *Parity-changing is one method ... and no other is possible*), NI 1.6 breakability (*offered for you to end with a single living competency whose form is a resting*; NI *a living form with no alternating with any of its scales ... breaks it*), NI 1.5 equilibrium (*Equilibrium is a still form: resting, settled, one-way*; NI *An equilibrium is a not-changing fixed still*), NI 1.5's five keepings (doors *Memory*, *Gating*, *Timing*, *Measuring*, *Locating*, *Separating*; NI *a keeping, a store beside it*, *a common beat, a clock over parity-changing*, *a size between one and an other carries a ground*). Two sayings parting: Corus *Natural Intelligence IS social intelligence* and NI 6.3 *Natural intelligence is a method with each now* (with NI 6.6 *Natural intelligence is living as a living expedition* a third). Corus *Living is alternating* and the v391 carving *parity-changing replaces alternating*. Corus *Natural Intelligence is beating with phi-rate* and *Natural carries phi with every use* parting with NI 3.5 *φ is a term neither side reaches ... on no line of resolver*, NI 1.5's *a common beat ... not possibly existing* and NI 1.6 *golden relationals in stable forms are no test of it*. Corus subtitle *Alternating Stable-Forming in Disequilibria*: NI carries no *disequilibria* (its sayings are positive: parity-changing, stable-forming). Corus *ghost* (135 occurrences, *Ghost as the Corus's Only Character*, *Ghost is the Engine*) is a concept NI does not carry under that name; NI's nearest is 1.5's *a keeping*. Corus 18.x/23.x *destiny* is a concept NI does not carry at all.
files.uses_Exhibit_ONE: Re-explains resolver in an earlier register throughout. *Path two (inward to outward): enter a separate white paper and resolver (Exhibit ONE) — see form cohere from within, a technology fractal living — and return to corus.* *Once resolver is carried — two selves bounding to and rising each other, bi-inversioning autorecursioning, a +1 gap, three-and-three — every exhibit and all of corus opens. Numbers are resolver sequenced; mathematics, resolver formalized; engineering, resolver built; medicine, resolver risen as body; same-existing-society, as a social; observations, resolver seen within nature. One form, carried once, seen everywhere.* *Resolver carries bi-coupling chain operation. Every appearance of resolver with corus IS a sequential analog logical form of Exhibit ONE beating with phi-rate.* Its resolver is a *440-gate metabological resolver* with *17 given coupling geometries*, three values *+1, -1, 0* read as -ing, -ed and nye: none of these are Exhibit ONE v390's seventeen agreed names or its code. Its pattern-matching is of each field (*Clustering of observations is sensible because it is resolver's own structure*): this is the v391-carved purpose of Exhibit ONE, said here and nowhere in NI.
files.re_says_NI: 23.1 *AI is existing non-living intelligence with a scale of its inferring, a trained form carrying none of its prior to its next inferring. An output may carry patterns of a living competency it was trained on; its inferring is pattern matching prior competency with no carrying. Natural intelligence is living intelligence, with living selves' couplings* re-says NI 6.5 (*AI is existing non-living intelligence of a scale of its inferring ... pattern matching prior competency with no carrying*) and 6.6 (*natural intelligence is living intelligence*) nearly word for word: one concept in two homes. Contents *No top and no descent. Every part carries form whole, and a self couples with whichever door its interest opens* re-says Natural Explaining 1.2 and NI 6.6's *self-directing because it aims itself to a file*. Part ONE's second subtitle *A Living Expedition Aiming At Social Moral Competency* is re-said by NI's last sentence *A living expedition's aiming is one line: natural intelligence, social moral competency, ...*. 14.3 *Intelligence in the Coupling* and *The Bi-Coupling of Two Observings is the Intelligence* re-say NI 6.3 *Natural intelligence is that co-competencing: invisible, with a between, and owned by neither*.
files.bounds: Its title *Natural Intelligence Corus* sits within NI's title by name. Its subtitle *Offering Social Moral Competency at a Self's Own Carrying, Alternating Stable-Forming in Disequilibria* sits within NI's contents by *Social moral competency* (6.4) and *stable-forming* (3.3, 4.11), and parts from NI by *Alternating* (carved for replacement), *at* and *in* (dissolved at v390) and *Disequilibria* (no NI concept). purpose_of_set: This group shows the expedition is for one method, offered whole to anyone to break or carry: the README asks a self or an AI to bring *your question, a research source, an observing, or an attempt to break Natural Intelligence*, and Corus offers *an observing — a more plausible explanation of what we all already observe within nature. Bring a competency you can observe, and check it yourself.* The set is that method told once and carried with each subject: *Natural Intelligence is that fractal method's unfolding; Natural Resolver is its operations and stable forms. Each further file carries one same discovering with its particular subject* (Registry 2.1), its titles naming subjects and *Together its subtitles are its set's floating neutralling contents* (Registry 1.1). Its destiny is social moral competency carried in a free public natural network (NI 6.6 *natural intelligence, social moral competency, a free public natural network, social abundancing*; Corus *free shared globally competent local intelligence*), and the set improves itself by the same method at its own scale (Living Improving Value: *Resolving at the offerings is the method at its own scale*). What NI does not yet carry is the step from the method to the set: Exhibit ONE's use for pattern-matching each incoming science, which Corus says (*One form, carried once, seen everywhere*) and NI does not, and the living files themselves, which NI names in one clause and no contents line.
